cohort: The study included neonates born at 35 weeks gestation or more, admitted to the NICU with respiratory distress and requiring respiratory support.
finding: Antibiotics were used in 56.1% of neonates with respiratory distress requiring respiratory support, with parity, gestational age, sex, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, and duration of respiratory support identified as significant predictors of antibiotic use.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with antibiotic use.
